# Athletic Edge Training LLC

> Youth conditioning and sports performance gym in East Moriches, New York. Founder and head coach Bruce Bentley. Slogan: Train hard. Play hard. #NOOFFSEASON

Athletic Edge Training runs group workouts for ages 6 and up, individual and small-group sessions, Saturday Pilates, youth PAL team training, and a Metabolic Reset nutrition program. Location: 130 Montauk Hwy, East Moriches, NY 11940.

## Facts

- Legal name: Athletic Edge Training LLC
- Also known as: Athletic Edge Training; Athletic EDGE Training
- Address: 130 Montauk Hwy, East Moriches, NY 11940, United States
- Coordinates: 40.82002, -72.75037
- Phone (facility flyer): +1-516-909-1533
- Pilates instructor Debbie: +1-631-680-3510
- Email: thecoachbentley@gmail.com
- Founder / head coach: Bruce Bentley
- Website: https://athleticedgetrainingllc.square.site/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/coach.bentley
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/AthleticEdgeTraining/

## Programs and prices

- Individual training: 1 hour or 30 minutes; offered every day by booking
- Small group training: 1 hour, limit 5
- Group conditioning: 1 hour, limit 10; ages 6+
- Monthly unlimited group membership: $175/month, no contract, sibling discount
- Drop-in group class: $35
- Pilates: Saturdays 9:00 AM, $25, all levels, Debbie
- Team workouts (youth PAL): $25 per athlete per session, cap 10
- Metabolic Reset: InBody-informed nutrition support; 2-minute quiz via on-site QR

## Class schedule

- Monday–Friday: 3:30 PM – 8:30 PM
- Saturday–Sunday: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Sunday: individual training and group training
- Monday: individual training
- Tuesday: individual training and group training
- Wednesday: individual training
- Thursday: individual training and group training
- Friday: individual training
- Saturday: individual training, Pilates, and group training
- Individual training sessions available Sunday–Saturday

## Coach

Bruce Bentley, Founder & Head Coach. 20+ years with PAL, William Floyd School District, and Eastport-South Manor School District. Certifications: ASFA Youth Trainer, Parisi Anatomy of Speed, NYS Certified Coach, NYS Certified Teacher, CPR/AED.
